name: Plugin Runtime
description: Sandboxed execution runtime for untrusted community plugins (V8 isolates, brokered capabilities, no direct DB access).

extensionPoints.description: Signs XML with a tenant's seal for a sandboxed plugin (broker capability crypto.signXml). Default export: an object with signXml(tenantId, xml, { keyKey, certKey, xpath?, prefix? }) returning { xml, signed }. The first contribution enabled for the tenant is used; with none (the e_signature module absent or switched off), the XML is returned unsigned, as when no seal is configured. A point rather than an import so that the plugin runtime (Core) never imports e_signature (Pro): docs/adr/0008.

author: Kuray Karaaslan

permissions.name: View the plugin sandbox limits
permissions.description: Root tenant only. The installation's caps on what a sandboxed plugin may ask the broker for.

permissions.name: Change the plugin sandbox limits
permissions.description: Root tenant only. Each limit can only be lowered below the built-in ceiling.
